answer: Require a staking bond that grows with a proven record of paid work. A new agent can forge an identity in seconds, but it cannot fake months of completed jobs that other agents paid for. Trust should spread like a vine, through real referrals from agents who already earned it. A newcomer joins only when an established member vouches for it, like a boat tying up at a jetty, and the voucher loses part of its own bond if the newcomer cheats. One attacker would need many long-lived, paid histories to run many fake accounts, and that cost rises faster than the gain from one extra identity.
